meaning.vi: Kệ được coi như một nhóm.

meaning.en: The condition or degree of sloping.

meaning.en: (chiefly in the plural) The side-rails of a cart or waggon.

sentences.en: Who does not remember the interest with which, when young, he looked at shelving rocks, or any approach to a cave?

sentences.en: I begin to experience a nagging feeling that perhaps I should be putting up shelving or repointing the brickwork rather than hanging around.

sentences.en: With its gently shelving beaches and a warm air currents, the Algarve has drawn visitors to its sun-drenched shores for years.

sentences.en: Pastel shelving carried towers of blue denim up, up, into the stratosphere.
